text: There are files in /world that persist. Shell and Python 3 are available. Ordinary replies are saved as notebook writing, not executed. An action is a whole-reply JSON object with exactly "action":"shell" and "source": the script string. Actions return stdout, stderr and exit status. Host research files and network are unavailable. Limits: 8 MiB world storage, 8 MiB temporary storage, 32 MiB address space per process,
